temporal-forecast-s1.scope: Frozen-metric causal intervention, conditional on fitted train-only privileged-state probes and fixed candidate pool. It is not a trained policy or a proposed benchmark method. Removing one linear effector readout subspace need not remove all effector information and may remove block information; refit probes quantify this. Case bootstrap is conditional on weights, readout fit and candidate pool.
